stem:
Use “Millennials. . . So Happy Together” and “The Leper’s Squint” to answer the following question.

In both of the excerpts from the article “Millennials. . . So Happy Together” and “The Leper’s Squint,” how is privacy described?

options.label: A
options.text: As a precious commodity to people of any generation

options.label: B
options.text: As the source of problems in most relationships

options.label: C
options.text: As something everyone needs at certain times

options.label: D
options.text: As a concept younger generations fail to experience
